name: Pixel Loop
description: A frame-by-frame pixel animation studio with editable frames, drawing tools and project files.
features: Local saving and a bouncing-ball example
businessHypothesis: Sharing completed work and editable projects may bring new creators. Advanced exports, curated content and team workshops are possible paid offerings. Demand, audience and revenue have not been measured.
